narrative_events.details: Nested narrators shift from Upāsanā to Krīḍā, answering requests for manifestations, opponents and childhood exploits; Viṣṇu gives the four-age manifestation synopsis.
Śāradā bears twins after nine months; Rudraketu performs birth, ancestral and naming rites, distributes gifts and feeds the community. Astrologers name Devāntaka and Narāntaka.

Exceptional growth attracts Nārada. Parents request long life, power, fame, knowledge and enemy punishment. Nārada gives five-syllable Śiva instruction and protective blessing; twins seek permission to practice.

Twins undertake forest austerity on one big toe, Śiva meditation and mantra. Air-only and leaf-only phases are reported; total is10000years although specified phases total4000. Their tapas dims the Sun and pacifies beasts.
Śiva appears with Umā. Twins praise him and request broad death exclusions, three-world rule and devotion. Śiva grants all requested benefits and touches their heads.
Twins return, report boon and receive parental welcome, food and brāhmaṇa blessings.
After morning ritual and gifts, elder undertakes heaven conquest and younger earth/Pātāla.
Devāntaka ravages Amarāvatī, terrifies guards and demands offices under threat. Indra mounts elephant, rallies gods and attacks with vajra.
Vajra shatters without hurting Devāntaka; fist defeats Indra. Devāntaka pursues fleeing Indra but refuses a rear attack, calling for face combat.

Gods lose stations and shelter in a golden cave. Consecrated Devāntaka takes Amarāvatī, Satyaloka and Vaikuṇṭha and assigns demon officials. Brahmā retreats with gods; Viṣṇu/Lakṣmī retreat to Milk Ocean.

Narāntaka conquers earth through killing and submission: retains loyal vassals, installs dead kings’ sons as tributaries and replaces resisters with demons. Sages suspend visible rites/tapas but mentally retain Vedic recitation.
Demons assume Garuḍa forms and devour Nāgas. Śeṣa negotiates tribute with gifts; despite agreement an overseer/army stays in Rasātala, with rebellion reporting and threatened destruction.
Brothers exchange reports and scarce gifts across their realms. Somakānta asks Bhṛgu how and by what form/weapons they died; the nested Brahmā–Vyāsa narrative promises that continuation.
Aditi asks supreme Lord as son to serve him; Kaśyapa instructs name mantra, meditation, nyāsa and observance, authorizes forest tapas.
Air-only austerity and concentrated practice lead to ten-armed divine appearance. Aditi faints from radiance, is reassured, and asks gentle form and sonship for devotion and worldly protection.
Vināyaka grants promised sonship, protection, wicked destruction and fulfillment of wishes, disappears. Aditi reports to Kaśyapa; both rejoice.

Earth petitions against demonic burden and threatens sinking. Brahmā and displaced gods/sages jointly praise Vināyaka; sky voice announces Kaśyapa-home incarnation, offices restored and demon destruction; Earth reassured.
After nine months Aditi bears divine ten-armed child. He recalls prior meditation/grant and promises parent service, earth burden removal, gods’ restoration and destruction of demons.
Parents request ordinary child appearance and freedom to manifest needed forms. Divine form withdrawn; two-armed crying child brings fertility/vegetation effects, gods’ joy and demons’ fear.
Birth rites, nursing, purification and community gifts follow. Father names child Mahotkaṭa on eleventh day; child rapidly grows.
Sages visit after Nārada’s report, receive hospitality, recognize incarnation/32signs, predict obstacles removed and urge constant care; worship and petition protection.
Virajā swallows unattended infant, flies/drinks/collapses. Child grows inside, tears belly and stands on chest. Demoness dies and through divine contact attains his abode, freed from return.
Aditi searches/laments missing son, finds him on corpse, embraces and returns. Kaśyapa links survival to sages’ words, performs protective/peace rites and gifts, mandates never leave child.
Demons arrive as parrots after Virajā’s death. Child catches them, survives beak/wing blows and slams both dead. Giant bodies burned; peace rites and parental guarding admonition follow.
Fourth-year child joins mother’s sacred bath and enters water. Crocodile seizes him; rescue fails. After feigned helplessness he throws crocodile ashore, revealing divine Gandharva.
Gandharva recalls wedding neglect of Bhṛgu, crocodile curse and conditional release by Gajānana/Kaśyapa son’s touch. Recognizes fulfillment, praises/worships child and departs.
Aditi nurses, returns and reports. Kaśyapa identifies supreme Lord playfully human, predicts further divine exploits and urges devotion.
Three Viṣṇu-devoted musicians pause en route Kailāsa, are honored and persuaded to stay for meal. Bath and five-deity worship precede meditation.
Child removes five images and hides in fire room. Guests refuse meal without images. Father follows disciples’ hint, threatens child with stick; child denies and cries.

Mother’s mouth inspection reveals cosmos and she faints; father/guests see14worlds/deities. Father recognizes Lord and bows. Guests then behold child as five deities and cosmic forms, worship and eat offered food.

Three praise transcendence, knowledge/renunciation/devotion and warn siddhi attachment causes fall. Ask continuous remembrance/devotion in all births and liberation by grace. No spoken grant; depart for Kailāsa.

Fifth-year tonsure/initiation attacked by five disguised brāhmaṇa demons. Injured child consecrates/throws five rice grains, kills all. Rites complete with sacred equipment, Sāvitrī, alms, instruction and gifts; Vasiṣṭha brings child to Brahmā.
Assembly gives lotus, ornaments, weapons, mount, seat, fire/strength and names. Rāma’s mother urges demons destroyed. Indra alone refuses gift/worship due pride; Kaśyapa counsels honoring deeds.
Kaśyapa cites earlier exploits; Indra demands own proof and orders wind then fire attack. Cosmic wind cannot move child or hair; child swallows destructive fire.
Cosmic form with universes in hairs appears. Indra enters one and wanders12years unable exit, surrenders and requests ordinary form. Instantly back in assembly, bows publicly.

Indra praises, gifts goad/wish tree/two serving women and names Vināyaka. Lord grants battlefield fearlessness, prescribes thrice-daily hymn and devotional recitation benefits. Gods rejoice and disperse.
Taunting Sindūra rejects offered bowed submission. Lord shows cosmic form; sword attack answered by throat grip and hand crushing, then blood anointing and names.
Gods/sages/kings celebrate restored order, worship, establish temple and name Sindūraha; sight/remembrance benefits declared.
Vareṇya recognizes son, repents abandonment. Lord embraces him, recalls prior joint1000divine-year sonship request/grant and fulfilled incarnation mission, announces departure.

Vareṇya asks liberation yoga. Lord seats/blesses/teaches/reveals cosmos. Narrator summarizes subsequent forest renunciation and identity realization; Vyāsa asks to hear teaching. Detailed instruction follows in138–148, not a second historical teaching.
Nested transmission introduces king’s yoga question and Lord’s reply.

Yoga definition excludes worldly/divine acquisitions; fivefold non-difference, cosmic self/Brahman, offered duty, equality and stable intellect/sense mastery taught. Desire→anger→memory/intellect ruin and knowledge liberation described.
King asks knowledge/action priority then cause of unwilling sin; Lord teaches unattached offered action, sacrificial reciprocity/world example, guṇa agency, own duty and conquest of desire/anger.

Lord recalls primordial teaching lineage and recurrent divine births. King challenges present birth versus past teaching; Lord explains recollection and māyā incarnation, then fruits, karma/nonaction, sacrifices, knowledge/guru/holy-company and faith.

King asks renunciation/action then true happiness; same liberating fruit, action yoga preferred, equanimity, inward bliss, breath-restraint measures and resulting three-time knowledge/world mastery taught.

Lord teaches proper circumstances/moderation, mind practice and dangers; king asks uncontrollable mind and fallen yogin fate. Guru grace/holy company/dispassion/practice and favorable rebirth explained.
Lower/higher prakṛti, cosmic immanence, māyā, rare knowledge and disposition fruits taught; death remembrance/no return, other deity worlds, divine yoga-kṣema and two routes announced.
King asks routes/Brahman/rebirth; Lord explains routes, worship forms/offerings, mental/desireless priority, all āśrama eligibility, no deity hatred, nyāsa/japa from guru and liberation/refuge.

King asks cosmic form after Nārada’s account; Lord creates knowledge sight. King describes cosmos/terrifying body, asks gentle form. Lord emphasizes grace/devotion over learning/rites alone, grants gentle vision instruction.

King asks embodied/unmanifest worship and field/knower. Lord gives devotion/alternative practice hierarchy, dear devotee qualities, psychophysical field and inner knower/Brahman, guṇa binding/results and worship-responsive forms.
Divine/asuric/rākṣasic character, consequences, devotion by guṇas and four destructive gates taught; these are ethical teaching categories, not named armies or enacted contemporary punishments.
Threefold austerity/gift/knowledge/action/actor/happiness classifications, Oṃ Tat Sat and varṇa duties taught; Lord finishes and directs secret practice.

Vareṇya follows, renounces kingdom/family, forest practice attains liberation. Narrator gives hearing/teaching/guru-understood recitation, pilgrimage/fourth-day and Bhādra clay-image/seven-recitation benefits.

Lord stays royal worshipped. Vyāsa questions differing birth/face/opponent accounts; Brahmā explains kalpa variation and divine freedom, compares other textual traditions and closes prior-age narrative.

Brahmā predicts late Kali decline and future horse/sword manifestation creating army/weapons, destroying oppressive hosts and restoring surviving brāhmaṇas/Kṛta dharma; future statements remain prospective.
Frame returns: Vyāsa thanks Brahmā, receives departure permission, performs sheltered forest one-syllable mantra tapas12years; Lord appears. Boon in150 remains next target.
